gen-gf-comic-relief-archivo: The text reads editorial and approachable, curves opening outward rather than curling in, under a Comic Relief heading. Archivo does the quiet work with its high lowercase, while Comic Relief is the one built to shout.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-epilogue: Comic Relief leaves its bowls unfinished on one side and draws no difference between up and side strokes. Epilogue's wire-like, unclamped curves make the loudness easier to live with.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-merriweather-sans: Commanding by nature, Comic Relief draws every glyph with a single-width stroke, while Merriweather Sans keeps a clean, sturdy look. Shrink that heading and its weight would fade fast.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-science-gothic: Comic Relief leaves its bowls unfinished on one side. Science Gothic is the counterweight, stroke ends set far apart and uniform lines throughout, so you take in one letter at a time.
gen-gf-comic-relief-switzer: Commanding, Comic Relief draws up and side strokes alike, leaving its bowls unfinished on one side. Switzer, Swiss and tubular with a high waist line, does the reading while the heading does the shouting.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-alexandria: Expressive spaghetti-like strokes carry Funnel Display, every line the same width. Alexandria below it keeps its c terminals wide and its stems short above and below, giving the loose heading a clean partner.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-devanagari: Cord-like and expressive, Funnel Display keeps every stroke one width. Anek Devanagari, a modern sans-serif with distinctly open letter mouths and a large middle zone, should read smoothly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reaches high with a squared-off woodblock x-height, its terminals stopping far from the stem. Anek Kannada and Funnel Display pull apart usefully, a pen line holding one width above a blocky, contemporary body.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-telugu: Funnel Display draws its round letters like bent wire, loose and spaghetti-like, with every stroke the same width. And Anek Telugu sets a clean reading rhythm with wide bowls left unsealed like an unlatched hook.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-arimo: Arimo reads neutral and professional, with spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs. Funnel Display is best at making a statement, each letter traced with one marker, while Arimo is best at sitting quietly beneath it.
